posts.content: PubMed 摘要：情緒聚焦治療對成人困擾型精神病理的系統性回顧與統合分析，含樣本、效果量與研究限制。
posts.title: PubMed 論文（PMID: 42002402）

summary_en: Published online 19 April 2026 in Psychotherapy Research. A systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical trials of emotion-focused therapy (EFT) for distress-based psychopathology in adults, including depression, generalised anxiety, PTSD and borderline personality symptomology. Thirteen articles met inclusion criteria (n=348 receiving EFT; n=201 controls). EFT significantly outperformed inactive controls (g=1.39, 95% CI 1.06-1.72) but not other psychotherapies (g=0.28, 95% CI -0.19 to 0.76). The authors note publication bias, a strong focus on women and White/Iranian populations, and largely poor study quality with small samples, inadequate randomisation and unaccounted dropouts, concluding EFT appears modestly effective and calling for more rigorous, diverse trials.
summary_zh: Psychotherapy Research 2026-04-19 線上刊出。情緒聚焦治療（EFT）對成人困擾型精神病理（抑鬱、廣泛焦慮、PTSD、邊緣人格症狀）的系統性回顧與統合分析，納入 13 篇臨床試驗（EFT 組 n=348，對照組 n=201）。EFT 明顯優於非積極對照組（g=1.39，95% CI 1.06–1.72），但與其他心理治療比較無顯著差異（g=0.28，95% CI −0.19–0.76）。作者指出研究質素普遍較差、樣本小、隨機化不足、脫落未處理，並有出版偏倚跡象，樣本以女性及白人／伊朗人為主；結論是 EFT 似乎有中等療效，呼籲以更嚴謹、多元的設計再驗證。
supervision_questions: EFT 與其他心理治療比較無顯著差異，你會如何向個案說明選擇 EFT 的理據，而不誇大其獨特性？
這篇統合分析的研究質素普遍較差，你在督導中會如何教導實習生評估這類證據？
title_en: Meta-analysis: EFT modestly effective for distress-based psychopathology in adults, no edge over other psychotherapies
title_zh: 統合分析：EFT 對成人困擾型精神病理有中等療效，但不比其他心理治療優勝
